_about: Measurer-side SEIFA blocks for the statistics-era federal frames (1993/1996 elections): era census-CD cubes x the era division sets, weighted per ABS 2039.0 sect.2.2. IRSD/IER/IEO only — IRSAD predates its SEIFA-2001 invention by neither census. Ranks rank 1 = most disadvantaged (the store's convention). See derive-division-seifa-stats90s.py.
